notablePrerequisites: Pollenbright Wings attached to a creature with power five or greater that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Pollenbright Wings attached.
Pollenbright Wings triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod's second ability five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If the creature has power six or greater, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.
